text: Adele Fiona Boone, an Electrical Engineer, has triggered two detection rules this week. The first anomaly is a significant increase in logons outside her typical working hours, with 4 events recorded, which is well above her usual range. The second anomaly is an unusual volume of visits to job-search sites, with 70 visits recorded, which is more than double her typical range and even above the average for her peers in the same role.
